Topic 2.2: Mass

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Mass. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-1/mathematics/page-057.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1 — page 57]]

From your pupil's book (page 57)

TERM 1 Week 9 Lesson 1 Measuring mass Activity 1 Activity 2 What is the mass? What is the mass?

The mass of the book The mass of the book is ____dusters is ____ marbles

1. The mass of an exercise book is ____ pencils.

2. The mass of an exercise book is ____ rubbers.

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-1/mathematics/page-118.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1 — page 118]]

From your pupil's book (page 118)

TERM 2 Week 8 Lesson 3 Measuring mass Activity 1 Activity 2 Measure mass of duster Measure mass of duster

The duster is ______ The duster is ______ pieces of chalk pencils

1. The exercise book is ______ bottle tops.

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-1/mathematics/page-119.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1 — page 119]]

From your pupil's book (page 119)

Activity 1 Activity 2 Measure mass of Measure mass of wooden block wooden block

The wooden block is The wooden block is ______ rubbers. ________ sticks.

1. The wooden block is __________ pencils.

2.The wooden block is _________ exercise books 105

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Mass means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Mass.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Mass
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 1
4. Revise with the quiz now.
